title: Where starch digestion can start
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: Salivary amylase can begin starch digestion in the mouth. Further carbohydrate digestion occurs later in the small intestine.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: In which part of the digestive tract can salivary amylase begin breaking down starch? Salivary amylase can begin starch digestion in the mouth. Further carbohydrate digestion occurs later in the small intestine.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
